title: HPR Community News April 2024
blurb: The HPR team reviews April 2024 shows, welcomes new host Dave Hingley, and discusses listener feedback.

speakers.name: Speaker 1
speakers.voice: Female, automated/text-to-speech announcer, clear British accent, measured pace, slightly high pitch.

speakers.name: Ken Fallon
speakers.voice: Male, Irish accent, conversational and energetic pace, mid pitch.

speakers.name: Dave Morriss
speakers.voice: Male, British/English accent, warm and slightly raspy tone, relaxed pace, mid-to-low pitch.

summary.purpose: The hosts met to summarize and discuss the podcast episodes and listener comments released throughout April 2024.

keyTakeaways.point: Dave Hingley was officially welcomed as a new HPR podcast host.
A seasonal slowdown in community show submissions was noted for this time of year.
Ongoing infrastructure tasks include website static file management and media tracking.

topics.heading: Introduction and New Hosts
points: Opening greetings and context for the April community review.
Welcoming Dave Hingley as the newest HPR host.

topics.heading: April Show Reviews and Feedback
points: Reviewing various community shows released throughout April 2024.
Discussing listener comments on topics ranging from Linux to JQ and text-to-speech.

topics.heading: Website Infrastructure and Show Notes
points: Addressing issues with markdown syntax highlighting in show notes.
Discussing static file tracking and potential use of git annex.

nextSteps: Continue working on website infrastructure and static file synchronization.

actionItems.text: Look into markdown syntax highlighting restrictions for show notes.

highlights.label: Discussing Linux anniversaries and car software
Exploring git annex for media tracking
